prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080, drawn as a FULL-BLEED EDGE-TO-EDGE illustration.

FRAMING - READ THIS FIRST: There is NO page border, and there must be NO empty white margin strip around the scene either. Draw everything BIG: the scene must be zoomed in close and BIGGER than the square canvas, so the square physically CROPS it on every side - the blanket must run off the bottom edge, and at least two of the other props (the bathtub, the bottle, the rocking chair, the bear) must be cropped by the left, right or top edge, touching or crossing the very edge pixels of the canvas. Do not shrink the whole scene to fit inside comfortably with breathing room; that is wrong. Fill at least 95% of the square with linework - only small gaps of white between individual objects are acceptable, never a wide open margin band along an entire edge. Do NOT draw a rectangle, a double rule, a thin outer line, a box, or a panel edge anywhere.

SCENE: A friendly round CHICKENPOX VIRUS character (varicella-zoster virus) sits happily in the middle of a cozy bedtime scene. It is a chunky round ball; all the way around its rim sit about sixteen SHORT, THICK, BLUNT STUDS, each a small rounded bump WIDER THAN IT IS LONG, sitting directly on the rim with no stalk, no stem and no neck - like the squat teeth of a friendly cog wheel or the soft knobs on a toy ball. Each stud is a closed rounded shape a child can colour in; they must never be thin lines, spikes, pins, rays or anything radiating. The virus has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a warm gentle smile, plus two little stubby arms, one of them waving hello.
Around it in the same scene: a big soft folded BLANKET fills the lower half of the picture, its fabric texture shown with a few simple wavy fold-lines, running off the bottom, left and right edges; a round friendly NIGHTLIGHT (a chunky lamp shape with a smiling crescent-moon bulb) sits in one back corner - draw ONLY the lamp's own solid outline and its little stand; it must have NO glow effect at all around it: no rings, no arcs, no radiating lines, no sparkle marks and no halo of any kind near the lamp or anywhere else on the page; a cheerful round BATHTUB full of bubbles sits to one side, a few big simple bubble circles floating above it, offered as the cool soothing bath; a chunky bottle of SOOTHING LOTION with a friendly smiling face and a big round dropper stands nearby, one big round drop above its tip; and in the far corner a cosy ROCKING CHAIR holds a soft round GRANDPARENT teddy-bear character with a gentle smile getting a big friendly BANDAGE with a heart on it on one arm (the separate shingles vaccine for grown-ups), while right beside the chickenpox virus a smaller round BANDAGE character with its own happy face and a heart on it represents the childhood chickenpox vaccine. Everything is drawn large, simple and chunky so a child can colour inside every shape. Do NOT draw any human child, any skin, any rash, any spots, blisters or bumps on a person anywhere in the scene - keep the whole picture to the virus character, the cosy bedroom objects, and the two soft bandage/teddy characters described above.

STYLE - coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with generous white space inside them.
- Playful, warm and reassuring - nothing gruesome, no distressed or unhappy faces anywhere, no needles being administered, no sick or itchy imagery of any kind.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN - the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, double rule, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box or vignette anywhere near the edges of the square. NO frame of any kind.
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion lines, glow rings, glow arcs, or halo of rays behind, around or under the character, the lamp, or anywhere else. This includes short curved open "glow" arc-lines beside a lamp or light bulb - those count as radiating decoration too and are forbidden. NO open/unclosed decorative arc or ray lines of any kind anywhere on the page - every line must belong to a real, closed, colourable object. The virus's studs must stay short, blunt, closed and clearly attached to a solid rim so the character never reads as a burst or a star.
- ANY wide empty white margin or gutter running along a whole edge of the square with no linework crossing it.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO human figures, no skin, no rash, no pox marks, no blisters drawn on any character.
- NO lipid envelope drawn as a membrane halo, NO long spikes, NO tail, NO legs beyond the two little stubby arms.
